tagline: Stereo delay up to 2 seconds with feedback and ping-pong
description: A stereo delay built on a circular buffer, with delay time from 1 ms to 2 s, feedback up to 99%, and a wet/dry mix. Ping-pong mode feeds the left delay line into the right channel's feedback. Input and output meters show levels.

features.name: Delay Time
features.description: 1 ms to 2 s, with the knob skewed toward short times

features.name: Ping-Pong
features.description: The right channel's feedback is taken from the left delay line instead of its own

useCases: Vocal slapback - quick doubling (80-120 ms, low feedback)
Long ambient echoes - 500-800 ms with high feedback
Dub-style throws - 375 ms (dotted eighth at 120 BPM), automate Mix
learningFocus: Circular buffer implementation for delay lines
Multi-channel processing with shared write position
Real-time parameter control (delay time, feedback, mix)
Showing a 0-1 parameter as a percentage

algorithms.name: Circular Buffer Delay
algorithms.description: Delay line that wraps its read and write positions around a fixed buffer

algorithms.name: Ping-Pong Feedback
algorithms.description: The right channel takes its feedback from the left delay line
